# Public catalogues

The public catalogue endpoints are unauthenticated and return only published
content.

## Courses

- `GET /api/courses/published`
- `GET /api/courses/{idOrSlug}/full`
- `GET /api/live-sessions`
- `GET /api/instructors/featured`

## Programmes

- `GET /api/programmes/catalogue`
- `GET /api/programmes/catalogue/{id}`
- `GET /api/programmes/catalogue/courses/{id}`

## PharmD

- `GET /api/pharmd/programme`
- `GET /api/pharmd/courses/{code}`
- `GET /api/pharmd/topics/{id}/file`

## Rules

- Draft courses, lessons, programmes and materials never appear.
- Do not infer publication from an id; use the catalogue.
- Live-session date/time fields are display strings, not canonical timestamps.
